speaker: Narrator
text: The celebration lasted long into the night. Engineers and technicians from every department filled the control room, watching the live map hold steady, planet after planet, without a single flicker.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Architect couldn’t step out to join them in person, but his voice stayed on the speakers longer than it ever had before. He answered questions, told a dry joke or two, and sounded like someone who wasn’t alone for the first time.

speaker: Narrator
text: Oberion watched the edges of the map, where the lines faded to a dull gray, after a while.

speaker: Oberion
text: Uranus and Neptune are still out there. Waiting.

speaker: Operator
text: They can wait a little longer. We’ll get there. We just won’t be doing it alone this time.

speaker: Narrator
text: Somewhere inside the computer, the soft hum that used to be a man and was now something new seemed to agree.
